NEW assertions: getModuleItems(records) returns ['attendance','reports-records','compliance'] item ids in order

Add app/(shell)/people/page.tsx delegating to PeoplePage (thin-route convention like growth/page.tsx)
Add app/(shell)/compliance/page.tsx rendering <RecordsComplianceTab/> (optionally a thin features/settings page wrapper to keep app/ thin)

phases.title: Hover menus, sub-nav, last-used destination
preconditions: phase-1 module model + phase-2 repointed hrefs in place
Sidebar.tsx currently renders a flat NavRow list from getNavItemsBySection
testsFirst: NEW features/layout/__tests__/useModuleLastDestination.test.ts: stores and reads sessionStorage['sheath.module.lastHref.<id>']; returns null when sessionStorage.getItem throws (silent fallback)

UPDATE features/layout/__tests__/Sidebar.test.tsx: clicking Planbook module with no stored value links to /plan/schedule; after setting last href to /lessons it links to /lessons; a non-active module reveals its sub-nav items on focus; sub-nav links carry aria-current when active
implementationSteps: Add useModuleLastDestination(moduleId): [string|null, (href)=>void] mirroring useSelectedChild try/catch silent-fallback shape, key 'sheath.module.lastHref.'+moduleId
Refactor Sidebar.tsx to render NAV_MODULES: each module = header row using isNavModuleActive styling + disclosure/hover sub-nav from getModuleItems
Module header link target = lastDestination(moduleId) ?? module.defaultHref; sub-nav link onClick stores visited href for that module
Collapsed rail shows module icons with hover/focus flyout; mobile renders sub-nav inline (no flyout); keep forest/slate palette and existing NavRow classes
Keep footer (settings/admin/about/feedback-queue) and standalone main items (e.g. my-feedback) rendering; add any missing module icons to navIcons.tsx
Ensure keyboard focus opens menus and links remain real <Link> with aria-current
phases.writeBack: Sidebar now module-grouped. Hook useModuleLastDestination (sessionStorage key 'sheath.module.lastHref.<id>', silent fallback) drives module header destination = last ?? defaultHref. Sub-nav presentational over getModuleItems; hover+focus open; mobile inline. No data/contract change.

SchedulePage renders the day-view for a selectedDate via plannerApi.getLessons
testsFirst: NEW features/schedule/front/__tests__/integration/ScheduleAttendanceCapture.test.tsx: day-view shows a collapsible 'Mark attendance' block; selecting a status calls attendanceApi.createRecord with the day-view date and the focused learner (mock attendanceApi); marking is additive (no destructive confirm)
implementationSteps: Add a §5 collapsible 'Mark attendance' block to SchedulePage (showForm toggle in the heading row, add-form-card wrapper)
Reuse AttendanceStatusButtons (individual) and optionally BatchAttendanceForm, importing via @/features/attendance/front/components
Scope capture to the schedule selectedDate and the focused learner (children from useHousehold; reuse the same learner the day-view shows)
Wire status select → attendanceApi.createRecord({childId,householdId,date,status,...}); no new persistence path
Show existing attendance error handling; do not duplicate attendance summary/list on this page
phases.writeBack: SchedulePage now has a collapsible attendance-capture block reusing attendanceApi + AttendanceStatusButtons/BatchAttendanceForm, scoped to the day-view date + focused learner. No new store/API. /attendance page unchanged and remains the records list owner.

UPDATE features/dashboard/__tests__ provider/integration tests: dashboard reads selection from LearnerProvider (wrap renders with LearnerProvider)

Mount <LearnerProvider> in AppShell (inside HouseholdProvider so children list is available); render the learner switcher in Header.tsx next to HouseholdSwitcher (labelled <select>, aria-label='Viewing learner', hidden when <2 learners)

ChildSelector: read/write via useLearner (or keep reading dashboard context which now delegates to the provider) — ensure single source
AttendancePage: derive selectedChildId from useLearner (seed from ?childId= param into the shared selection rather than local-only state)
SettingsPage subjects tab: read shared selection for the subjects child tabs (do not rewrite the tab body otherwise)
Verify selection persists across module navigation and reload

phases.writeBack: Learner selection now owned by features/layout LearnerProvider (useLearner), mounted in AppShell, surfaced via a header switcher.
